# Drift monitoring (generated by `python -m monitoring.drift_report`)

Reference: 3,000 emails sampled from the training corpora. Drift is flagged when at least half of the 9 monitored columns drift (Evidently `DataDriftPreset`: normed Wasserstein distance on numeric features, Jensen-Shannon on the predicted-spam flag, text-content drift on the text).

| Scenario | Current window | Drifted columns | Dataset drift | Predicted spam rate (ref → current) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| stable | 3,000 emails | 1/9 | no | 50.4% → 51.0% |
| new_source | 1,565 emails | 8/9 | **yes** | 50.4% → 99.6% |

Per-column detail is in `drift_summary.json`; the full interactive reports are the `drift_*.html` files (regenerate them locally, they are not versioned).
